source: Gangam et al.(2026), Equitable core imputations for max-flow, MST and b-matching games
evidence: Page defines edge players and coalition value as the maximum flow in the subgraph of those edges. It supplies the n-unit-capacity source-to-sink path and equal1/n allocation example.
author_inference: Every proper subset of path edges breaks all source-to-sink flow. Thus v(S)=0 for each proper coalition, the entire core is the nonnegative unit simplex, every H_i=1, and the largest simultaneous fraction is1/n. These deductions are attributed to our manuscript, not claimed as quoted theorems.
